Hello, keeper! You came to the right place.
I know you want to get a treasured card from my collection. But will have to work hard!
I will give you one card from collection 'Rideable Lutino' if you bring me 100 pieces of card dust.

My partner-in-law will leave a message in the calendar, where you can find out method to collection of card dust.

You did a great job!
Nice to work with you, keep your reward.

The material is insufficient.

Card dust X 100

Gather the needed materials and get reward!
